title: AI versus human sentiment classification - IMDb case study
task: Binary sentiment classification of long movie reviews.
reference: Primary: manual annotation of 200 reviews. Secondary: star-derived IMDb label (0/1).

title: AI versus human financial-news sentiment classification
task: Three-class sentiment classification of single financial-news sentences.
reference: Majority vote of 5-8 finance professionals, restricted to sentences with >=75% annotator agreement.
